caption: The drawing features a rectangular object in the center resembling a small embroidered purse or envelope with a curved flap. The main colors used are light gray for the background, with accents of red, green, yellow, and black forming the design. The flap is decorated with symmetrical motifs including red wavy lines, green shapes, gray animal-like figures, and small yellow dots. The body of the purse has a central section with a red basket or container holding flowers, flanked on either side by two yellow and black birds facing inward. The design is outlined and sectioned with green borders, and additional red wavy lines and green motifs appear around the border of the purse. The object is set against a plain, off-white background with a subtle gradient that darkens toward the edges. There is a small, neat signature or inscription in the lower right of the page.
title: Purse
